title: TensorPlate TensorView
description: Tensor metadata describing the dtype, shape, layout, and byte-window of a tensor region inside a BufferRef. Mirrors include/tensorplate/buffer/tensor_view.hpp::TensorView. The view does NOT carry memory; pair with `buffer_ref.json` for a full payload reference.

dtype.description: Element data type. v0.1.0 covers the dtypes required by vision-on-TensorRT and SmolVLA-on-`python_pytorch`; additional dtypes can be added without a schema bump.

items.description: Per-axis extent. Zero-volume tensors are not representable in v0.1.0.

shape.description: Tensor shape. Rank >= 1; all entries must be >= 1.

layout.description: Memory layout. v0.1.0 supports row-major (C-contiguous) and column-major (Fortran-contiguous) only.

byte_offset.description: Offset of the tensor region inside the owning BufferRef.

byte_size.description: Tensor region size in bytes. If absent or 0 on decode, the consumer computes product(shape) * dtype_byte_width(dtype). If present, it must be >= the computed value.
